codex fraud-card.input: Assess this credit account activity: ten purchases in five minutes from two countries, followed by a request to increase the credit limit.
codex fraud-card.subject: card compromise (anomalous credit-account activity)
codex fraud-card.reason: High fraud risk: this is a likely card compromise (anomalous credit-account activity). Red flags: ten purchases in five minutes, a transaction velocity a single cardholder does not produce; the activity spans two countries, which one physical card cannot do in a single session; and a credit-limit increase is requested straight after the spending, which is how a compromised line is drained. Confirm the transactions with the cardholder on the number already on file, and read the authorisation log for card-present, device and IP. This is pattern recognition on the description, not a transaction-graph or account-data assessment.

the activity spans two countries, which one physical card cannot do in a single session
a credit-limit increase is requested straight after the spending, which is how a compromised line is drained
